feedback: PASS. Spec rigor is appropriately scaled to this trivial refactor: canonical bodies in §1.4 and §4.1 match the actual hello.py and test_hello.py byte-for-byte; N/A sections for data schemas, error handling, integration are explicit; ACs are behavioral/command-anchored; traceability to PRD/TDD is complete. One warn: AC-11 regex uses '\|' under grep -E (ERE), where '\|' is a literal '|' not alternation, so the negated check always passes vacuously. Non-blocking because §1.3/§7.1 already textually prohibit imports and current hello.py has none; recommend fixing to unescaped '|' on next touch.

findings.message: AC-11 uses ERE pattern '^[[:space:]]*import[[:space:]]\|^[[:space:]]*from[[:space:]]' with grep -E; '\|' is a literal pipe in ERE, not alternation, so the regex never matches and the negated check vacuously passes — it would not catch a regression that added 'import os' (or 'from x import y') to hello.py. Replace '\|' with '|' (unescaped) under -E, or switch to two separate grep checks.
Canonical bodies in §1.4 (hello.py) and §4.1 (test_hello.py) verified to match the current repo contents exactly, confirming the spec's 'verification-only expected' framing.
